questions.section_heading_before: 一、单选题：本题共8小题，每小题5分，共40分。只有一项符合题目要求。
questions.question_markdown:
1. 某工厂生产$A$，$B$，$C$三种不同型号的产品，产量之比为$2:3:5$。现用分层抽样的方法抽取一个容量为$n$的样本，若样本中$A$型号的产品有8件，则样本容量$n=$（ ）
A. 80
B. 40
C. 60
D. 100

handwritten_answer.evidence_note: In C001 context and answer_ink, the handwritten mark inside the parentheses after 样本容量n= shows a straight left stem with two right-side lobes (small upper lobe, closed lower loop), matching B; no crossing-out or overwrite is present.

questions.question_markdown:
2. 在样本频率分布直方图中共有9个小矩形，若其中1个小矩形的面积等于其他8个小矩形面积和的$\frac{2}{5}$，且样本容量为210，则该组的频数为（ ）
A. 60
B. 56
C. 40
D. 28

handwritten_answer.evidence_note: In C002 context and answer_ink, the handwritten letter inside the parentheses after 频数为 shows two slanted strokes meeting at an apex with a horizontal crossbar, matching A; no competing stroke (no descending right stem of a 4) is visible.

questions.question_markdown:
3. 已知事件$A$、$B$相互独立，事件$A$发生的概率为$P(A)=\frac{1}{2}$，事件$B$发生的概率为$P(B)=\frac{1}{2}$，则“两个事件$A$、$B$至少有一个发生”的概率为（ ）
A. $\frac{1}{4}$
B. $\frac{1}{2}$
C. $\frac{3}{4}$
D. 1

handwritten_answer.evidence_note: In C003 context and answer_ink, the handwritten mark inside the parentheses is an open curve with a gap at the upper right and no straight left stem or closure, matching C rather than an open D or O.

questions.question_markdown:
4. 如图，空间四边形$OABC$中，$\overrightarrow{OA}=\vec{a}$，$\overrightarrow{OB}=\vec{b}$，$\overrightarrow{OC}=\vec{c}$，点$M$在$OA$上，且$\overrightarrow{OM}=\frac{2}{3}\overrightarrow{OA}$，点$N$为$BC$中点，则$\overrightarrow{MN}$等于（ ）
A. $\frac{1}{2}\vec{a}+\frac{1}{2}\vec{b}-\frac{1}{2}\vec{c}$
B. $-\frac{2}{3}\vec{a}+\frac{1}{2}\vec{b}+\frac{1}{2}\vec{c}$
C. $\frac{2}{3}\vec{a}+\frac{2}{3}\vec{b}-\frac{1}{2}\vec{c}$
D. $\frac{2}{3}\vec{a}+\frac{2}{3}\vec{b}+\frac{1}{2}\vec{c}$
<插图>

printed_anchors: typeset italic serif vertex labels M, A, B, C, N
regular evenly spaced dashed lines for hidden edges AC and MN
uniform thin straight line work forming tetrahedron OABC matching the printed stem 如图
handwriting_features: black pen vector decomposition lines (MA+AB+BN, 1/2 OA+(OB-OA)+1/2 BC) overlapping the upper region of the figure
freehand circle with arrowhead at the apex O
figure_observations.observed_features: In C004 figure_candidate_01 the tetrahedron skeleton is drawn with uniform thin straight edges and regular dashed hidden lines, and labels M, A, B, C, N are typeset italic serif, proving a printed base; black pen formula strokes and an arrow to the apex overlay its top region, so the source is mixed; the figure is uncrossed and corresponds to the printed stem 如图, 空间四边形OABC, so its role is the printed question figure.

handwritten_answer.evidence_note: In C004 context and answer_ink, the handwritten mark inside the parentheses after 则MN等于 shows a straight left vertical stem with one continuous outer bow closing at top and bottom, matching D; surrounding handwritten computation is scratch work and not part of the answer mark.

questions.question_markdown:
5. 若平面$\alpha$的法向量为$\vec{u}=(-1,2,4)$，平面$\beta$的法向量为$\vec{v}=(m,-1,-2)$，直线$l$的方向向量为$\vec{l}=(n,-2,-4)$，则（ ）
A. 若$\alpha\parallel\beta$，则$m=1$
B. 若$l\perp\alpha$，则$n=2$
C. 若$n=20$，则$l\parallel\alpha$
D. 若$m=-10$，则$\alpha\perp\beta$

handwritten_answer.evidence_note: In C005 context and answer_ink, the handwritten mark inside the parentheses after 则 shows a straight left stem with a single right bow, matching D; the pen X marks over printed option labels A and B are eliminations of non-chosen options and do not cancel the retained answer D.

questions.question_markdown:
6. 不透明的口袋内装有红色、绿色和蓝色卡片各2张，一次性任意取出2张卡片，则下列事件，与事件“2张卡片都为红色”互斥而不对立的个数为（ ）
①2张卡片都不是红色； ②2张卡片恰有1张是红色；
③2张卡片至少有1张是红色； ④2张卡片至多一张为红色。
A. 1
B. 2
C. 3
D. 4

handwritten_answer.evidence_note: In C006 context and answer_ink, the handwritten mark inside the parentheses after 个数为 shows a left stem with two right lobes, matching B; the ellipse around 互斥而不对立 is emphasis only, and the ticks/strikes on enumerators ①②③ are item markings, not answer cancellation.
